ops: Ingestion API used to directly ingest data using Data Collection Rules.

ops.x: The API version to use for this operation.
The immutable ID of the Data Collection Rule resource.
The streamDeclaration name as defined in the Data Collection Rule.
The content encoding of the request body which is always 'gzip'.
An opaque, globally-unique, client-generated string identifier for the request.

hv.x: The Data Collection Endpoint for the Data Collection Rule. For example, https://dce-name.eastus-2.ingest.monitor.azure.com
